description: 20-ply alternating composite beam layup; ordered from bottom surface to top surface.
orientation_reference: 0 degrees is aligned with the beam longitudinal axis; for the carbon 2x2 twill, the warp direction is aligned with the beam axis.
notes: The specified cured thicknesses are interpreted as 0.20 mm for carbon and 0.15 mm for glass.
The supplied elastic constants are representative numerical inputs, not measured properties of the user’s materials.
The 100 gsm glass is assumed to be unidirectional E-glass/epoxy because a 0 degree orientation was specified.
Carbon cured density assumes 42 percent resin by mass; glass assumes 40 percent resin by mass. These assumptions affect mass predictions.
The alternating CF/GF sequence is unsymmetric through the thickness and can produce extension-bending coupling.
All plies use 0 degree about the beam axis; for twill, the warp direction is aligned with the beam axis.

CF_TWILL_200GSM.assumptions: In-plane tensile moduli from a 2x2 twill carbon prepreg data sheet. GXY and Poisson ratio use representative fabric-composite values; transverse constants are placeholders.

GF_100GSM.assumptions: Assumed unidirectional E-glass/epoxy. In-plane values are representative published lamina constants; transverse symmetry and 40 percent resin mass fraction are assumptions.

sources.source: Gurit SE84LV prepreg datasheet, Revchem-hosted copy
sources.used_for: 2x2 twill carbon laminate 0-degree/90-degree modulus (60.6/61.6 GPa) and 42% resin content; the source reports a different exact ply thickness, overridden by the user’s 0.20 mm input.

sources.source: Representative UD glass/epoxy lamina constants (E1=38.6 GPa, E2=8.27 GPa, nu12=0.26, G12=4.14 GPa)
sources.used_for: In-plane elastic constants only; assumes UD E-glass/epoxy.

sources.source: Generic carbon fabric/epoxy elastic constants reference
sources.used_for: Representative G12=5 GPa and nu12=0.10 where the selected twill datasheet did not report them.
